content.comment_body: Hello [user_name], Does the full version of [product_name] allow you to install the program multiple times, for example, on several desktop computers and a laptop? I'm asking because some software products have installation limits. Thanks again, [user_name]
Hello, You can install it on multiple PCs, but it's important to review the license agreement for more details regarding legal use. Regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are interested in understanding installation limits and licensing details when using [product_name] on multiple computers. There is some confusion about the permitted number of installations, suggesting the licensing or documentation may not provide clear information.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to install [product_name] software on several devices easily and without restrictive licensing requirements.
